label: prop:q-laplacian-spectral-tower
title: The $q$-Laplacian spectral tower $[k]_q^2$ and its root-of-unity (Verlinde/ADE) truncation
html:
The q-Laplacian \Delta_q has eigenvalues given by the q-integer tower

  [k]_q^2, \qquad [k]_q = \frac{q^k - q^{-k}}{q - q^{-1}} \quad (k = 1, 2, 3, \ldots).

At a primitive root of unity q = e^{i\pi/r}, the q-integer [r]_q vanishes, and the spectrum truncates to the finite set

  \{\,[1]_q^2, [2]_q^2, \ldots, [r-1]_q^2\,\},

yielding the Verlinde / ADE quantum-dimension data of the truncated representation category. The surviving quantum dimensions are exact algebraic numbers in the cyclotomic field \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_r). By Kazhdan–Lusztig [kazhdan-lusztig1993-tensor-i], the semisimplified truncated category is the modular tensor category of level-(r-2) \mathrm{SU}(2) Wess–Zumino–Witten representations. That equivalence concerns representation categories only; no conformal field theory is constructed here, and the real substrate value q_0 is not a root of unity, so it lies outside this truncation.
